payload.reason: The evidence suggests that the authors believe humans' robustness to noise is due to their ability to utilize general knowledge, which is not the case for MRC models.

claims.text: Humans' robustness to noise is attributed to their ability to utilize general knowledge, unlike MRC models which rely solely on passage-question pairs.
The authors propose that integrating general knowledge into MRC models can enhance their robustness to noise, similar to human capabilities.
